data.headline: Pioneer Bancorp’s net loans rose 10.0% quarter over quarter

claims.text: Pioneer Bank’s net loans and leases reached $1.87 billion at June 30, 2026, up 10.0% quarter over quarter and 21.3% year over year.

citation.quote: RCONB529	Loans and leases, net of unearned income and allowance	1870864	1700958	1542860

claims.text: Pioneer Bancorp’s loan signal is generated at Pioneer Bank, National Association, a wholly owned subsidiary of the company.

citation.quote: Pioneer Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company”) is a mid-tier stock holding company whose wholly owned subsidiaries are Pioneer Bank, National Association (the “Bank”) and Pioneer Capital Markets, Inc.

claims.text: Pioneer Bancorp’s six-month 2026 cash-flow reconciliation included a $2,130 thousand provision for credit losses.
Pioneer Bancorp reported $216 thousand of loans transferred to other real estate owned during the six months ended June 30, 2026.

citation.quote: Loans transferred to other real estate owned | $216 | $595
